title: {{greeting}} , {{name}} 👋
content: This is your dashboard — your home base for everything related to your account. Here, you can track your surveys, check your rewards, and stay updated on your latest activity. Let’s take a quick walkthrough so you can see how everything works and easily find your way around.

title: Your Stats at a Glance
content: Here’s a quick snapshot of your survey activity, including the surveys you’ve participated in, completed, or been disqualified from.

title: Available Surveys
content: New surveys that match your profile will appear right here. Keep an eye out for surveys offering higher rewards.

title: Recent Activity
content: This is where you can view your recent survey activity and check the current status of each survey.

title: Your Profile Details
content: Here, you’ll find your date of birth, join date, email address, and mobile number. Tap the eye icon next to any field to view the details.

title: Payment Method
content: Add or update your preferred reward method — whether it’s a bank transfer, UPI, PayPal, or an Amazon gift card.

title: Social Accounts
content: Link your social media accounts here to stay connected and access potential perks and benefits in the future.

title: Current Rewards
content: This shows your current points balance and how close you are to the next payout threshold.

title: Your Activity Summary
content: A full breakdown of your surveys completed, disqualified, abandoned, and more all in one glance.

title: Rewards Processed Summary
content: Once your rewards are approved and processed for payout, you can view your complete reward history right here.

title: Your Profile Categories
content: Complete each category to build a more detailed profile. The more complete your profile is, the better your chances of being matched with relevant surveys.

title: Fill In Your Details
content: Answer the questions here, and tap Update anytime to keep your profile information up to date.

title: Survey Stats
content: See how many surveys are available, your total earning potential, and the average time and reward for each survey.

title: Browse Surveys
content: Filter surveys by higher rewards or shorter completion times, then tap any survey card to get started.

title: Recent Activity
content: Track the status of the surveys you’ve recently participated in, all in one place.

title: Rewards
content: Here’s a preview of your rewards history. As you complete surveys and earn rewards, your activity will appear here.

title: Referrals
content: Here’s a preview of your referral history. Once you start referring others, your referral activity will appear here.

title: Change Password
content: Keep your account secure by updating your password here whenever needed.

title: Survey Notifications
content: Choose how you’d like to receive notifications when new surveys become available for you.

title: Terms and Conditions
content: Review our terms and conditions anytime, right here.

title: Help & Support
content: This is where you can track your support tickets and check their status. Need help? Create a new ticket anytime, and our support team will be happy to assist! 🎉
